name: PLCK G171.9-40.7 (Webb)
blurb: PLCK G171.9-40.7, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: plckg171407-webb
story: Discovered by the Planck satellite, this hot, disturbed cluster of galaxies is one of the massive clusters Webb is using as a natural lens to hunt for faint, distant galaxies.

claims.text: PLCK G171.9-40.7 is a hot, X-ray luminous galaxy cluster found by Planck
The cluster is hot and disturbed
It hosts a giant radio halo
JWST VENUS (program 6882) observes PLCKG171-40.7 among 60 massive lensing clusters
